title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 32 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 32)

content.overview: Section 32 provides the statutory modes of termination of arbitral proceedings. Proceedings terminate by the final arbitral award or by an order of the arbitral tribunal in the circumstances specified in the provision, including withdrawal of the claim where appropriate or agreement of the parties, subject to the statutory limits.
